hero.title: Ssaffron: A Royal Indian Culinary Journey
hero.subtitle: Experience elevated authentic Indian cuisine, nestled within the luxurious Shangri-La Bengaluru.

about.title: The Ssaffron Story
about.paragraph1: Ssaffron is an authentic Indian restaurant, offering royal cuisines inspired by all four corners of India. Taking inspiration from the country's ancient cooking methods, Ssaffron celebrates the rich culinary heritage of India with an emphasis on seasonal, market-fresh, and home-grown produce.
about.paragraph2: Nestled within the Shangri-La Bengaluru, Ssaffron invites discerning diners to a sophisticated gastronomic experience. Enjoy our smart casual ambiance, with smoking permitted in our elegant outdoor area, as you savor a truly exceptional and authentic taste of India.
